VGG-16 block-end hierarchy with depth-adaptive DCT pooling

Source: R/hierarchy_spec.R
vgg16_block_end_spec.Rd

One tap at the end of each convolutional block, plus fc1 and pre-softmax logits. Convolutional blocks use dct_pool, and the number of spatial modes decreases from 6 x 6 in block 1 to 2 x 2 in block 5. Early blocks have few channels and fine spatial structure, so they keep more spatial modes; late blocks have many channels and coarse maps, so they keep fewer. This keeps the stages similar in width.

Usage

vgg16_block_end_spec(target_size = c(224, 224))

vgg19_block_end_spec(target_size = c(224, 224))

Arguments

target_size

Image resize dimensions passed to Keras.

Value

A vgg_hierarchy_spec; see vgg_hierarchy_spec.

Details

With the default 224 x 224 input the VGG-16 stages are:

StageLayerPoolerMapChannelsColumns
b1block1_conv2dct_pool(6, 6)224 x 224642304
b2block2_conv2dct_pool(5, 5)112 x 1121283200
b3block3_conv3dct_pool(4, 4)56 x 562564096
b4block4_conv3dct_pool(3, 3)28 x 285124608
b5block5_conv3dct_pool(2, 2)14 x 145122048
fc1fc1identity_pool()–40964096
logitsclassifier_logitsidentity_pool()–10001000

The first DCT column of every channel is its global average, so each convolutional block contains the usual average-pooled features plus low-frequency layout. DCT columns are not on a common scale across modes or stages (see dct_pool); standardize them before combining, as block_pca does by default.

vgg19_block_end_spec() uses the same poolers on the VGG-19 block-end layers (block3_conv4, block4_conv4, block5_conv4); map sizes and column counts are identical.

See also

vgg_hierarchy_spec to choose other taps or poolers.

Examples

spec <- vgg16_block_end_spec()
spec
#> VGG hierarchy spec (vgg16)
#>   Stages: b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, fc1, logits
#>   Taps:   block1_conv2, block2_conv2, block3_conv3, block4_conv3, block5_conv3, fc1, classifier_logits
#>   Pooling:
#>     b1      DCT pool 6 x 6 (zigzag)
#>     b2      DCT pool 5 x 5 (zigzag)
#>     b3      DCT pool 4 x 4 (zigzag)
#>     b4      DCT pool 3 x 3 (zigzag)
#>     b5      DCT pool 2 x 2 (zigzag)
#>     fc1     Identity pool
#>     logits  Identity pool
spec$pooling$b1
#> DCT pool 6 x 6 (zigzag)
